task: Verify compiler baseline and inspect Fast Debug integer comparison and for loop implementations
observation: The bootstrap capability discovery and compiler source structure in src/interpreter.hpp and src/moss.cpp directly revealed the exact lines causing Fast Debug Defect #1 (casting Int to double in compare() lines 1303-1304) and Defect #8 (unconditional RuntimeError on Stmt::Kind::For at line 1834).
impact: Allowed exact pinpointing of root causes and construction of targeted fix specifications without reverse-engineering lowered Rust or guessing interpreter behavior.

resolution.summary: Root causes verified from compiler source; targeted fixes for Fast Debug exact 64-bit integer comparisons and for loop AST execution formulated.
